tests.name: AgentFace blurb clamp (#3335)

srcDivergence: Deliberate, not stale — preview parameterization. The record's `OrgLegend` defaults `archetypes`, `loading` and adds loading/error states, so it renders standalone in a preview that mounts records with no props; the file's takes them as required props from its caller. Region-scoped check: the file's `OrgLegend` holds 7 substantive line(s) the record lacks — under the 8-line threshold at which parameterization stops being a full explanation, so it is treated as explained. NOT zero, though: if this component ever gained behaviour the record missed, those 7 line(s) are where to look. Refreshing from the file would discard the parameterization. Written by scripts/reconcile-record-src.cjs --annotate.
whenUse: A floating legend of relationship-archetype line styles, pinned to a canvas corner.
whenNot: A generic chart legend (color swatches, not line styles) - use Legend.
